clue.text: The most eminent of the French cutting donation

indicators.note: the gift word is sliced open by the French phrase placed into it

parts.note: a grant is a donation of money
des is French for 'of the' (plural)

explanation.surface: Someone asks which of the French elite is reducing a charitable gift.
explanation.definitionFit: Grandest is the superlative of grand, meaning most distinguished or eminent.

clue.text: Being in rags, the beggar is hardly flashy

indicators.note: being in tells us the answer is contained in the words that follow

explanation.surface: Dressed in rags, a beggar is hardly showy.
explanation.definitionFit: Garish means gaudy, tastelessly bright.

clue.text: Love and possibly dream about one

indicators.note: the reshuffled dream letters go round the numeral
possibly signals the letters of dream may be arranged another way

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Love, and perhaps dreams, concerning a single person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges DREAM to ADMRE, and 'about' puts it round I, ADM-I-RE.
explanation.definitionFit: To admire is to regard with warm approval, to like greatly.

clue.text: Light-weight article written for show

parts.note: a dram is a small unit of weight
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A trivial piece produced for display.
explanation.definitionFit: A drama is a play, a show for the stage.

clue.text: Appearing to understand old Chinese

parts.note: to see is to understand
Ming was the Chinese dynasty of 1368 to 1644

explanation.surface: Someone appears to grasp an ancient Chinese language.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeming means apparent, having an outward appearance.

clue.text: Split Oriental flower growing place

parts.note: to split or grass is British slang for informing on someone
E stands for East, the Orient

explanation.surface: A divided Eastern bloom is described as a place where things grow.
explanation.walkthrough: Grasse is a town in the south of France famous for growing flowers for its perfume industry. 'Split' is a verb meaning inform, as is the British slang 'grass'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Provence town is the centre of the perfume trade, surrounded by fields of jasmine and roses.

clue.text: Those in 28 say may be denser, it's revealed

indicators.note: may be suggests the letters can become something else

parts.note: the contraction gives its three letters

explanation.surface: Tenement dwellers may be more tightly packed, it is shown.
explanation.definitionFit: Residents are people who live in a place, such as those in a tenement.

clue.text: No universal remedy

explanation.surface: There is no single cure for everything.
explanation.definitionFit: Specific means particular rather than general, and is also an old term for a medicine targeted at one disease.

clue.text: Put in a spot, so make up

explanation.surface: Placed in a tricky position, so reconcile.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense splits the answer into END ANGER, which is what making up after a quarrel does.
explanation.definitionFit: To imperil someone, and, split in two, to finish a quarrel by being reconciled.

clue.text: Gives vent to anger about a politician causing storms

indicators.note: the anger word goes round, surrounding the article and the politician

parts.note: to rage is to give vent to anger
MP is Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An angry outburst against a politician stirs up trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To rampage is to rush about violently, as one storms through a place.

clue.text: Like a number, aim to get rise

parts.note: as means like, in comparison
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: Something like a figure tries to climb.
explanation.definitionFit: To ascend is to go up, to climb.

clue.text: Eager for silver turn-over

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the turn word is read backwards

parts.note: a go is a turn in a game

explanation.surface: Keen for a silver coin to be flipped.
explanation.definitionFit: Agog means eagerly excited and expectant.

clue.text: Mastering sports and running

indicators.note: sports is read as a verb, the letters of the word before it frolicking into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is getting good at games and athletics.
explanation.definitionFit: Streaming describes flowing or running liquid, as eyes or a nose do.

clue.text: See fit soldier retreating-in retreat

indicators.note: the reversed soldier sits within the retreat

parts.note: a den is a private retreat

indicators.note: retreating means going backwards, so the soldier is read in reverse

parts.note: GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier falling back into a hideaway decides it is appropriate.
explanation.definitionFit: To deign is to condescend, to think it worthy of oneself to do something.

clue.text: A small creature trodden underfoot by a stallion

explanation.surface: A little animal gets stamped on by a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is the frog of a horse's hoof, the horny pad on the underside that is pressed into the ground with each step.
explanation.definitionFit: A small amphibian, and also the elastic triangular pad on the sole of a horse's hoof.

clue.text: The restorer sticks a note on a piece of furniture

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
a dresser is a kitchen sideboard with shelves

explanation.surface: A furniture restorer attaches a label to a sideboard.
explanation.definitionFit: One who redresses puts right or remedies a wrong.

clue.text: Affecting grief about the United Nations' use of arms

indicators.note: the reshuffled grief letters sit around the abbreviation
affecting suggests the letters of grief are put on or altered

parts.note: UN is the abbreviation for United Nations

explanation.surface: Sorrow at the United Nations over the deployment of weapons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Affecting' reads as 'moving' in the surface, but it signals that the letters are put on in a new order: GFIRE, which 'about' wraps round the UN.
explanation.definitionFit: Gunfire is the shooting of guns, a use of firearms.

clue.text: A person offering help as a member of the family

parts.note: a sister is a family member

explanation.surface: Someone helps out in the role of a sibling.
explanation.definitionFit: An assister is one who aids or supports.

clue.text: Many always set about little beasts

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a large number
ever means always

indicators.note: about indicates the letters of set are moved around

explanation.surface: Many creatures always get involved with small animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Leverets are young hares in their first year.

clue.text: No mean individual as a writer

explanation.surface: A generous person who happens to be an author.
explanation.walkthrough: Stephen Spender was an English poet. 'No mean' means not stingy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who lavishes money, and the surname of the twentieth-century poet Stephen Spender.

clue.text: Indiscreet artists with aspiration

parts.note: RAs are Royal Academicians, members of the Royal Academy of Arts
aspiration is the breathed sound of the letter H

explanation.surface: Painters who are hasty in their ambition.
explanation.definitionFit: Rash means reckless, acting without thought or caution.

clue.text: Found everyone playing

explanation.surface: Discovered all the actors.
explanation.definitionFit: To found metal is to shape it in a mould, and the full company of actors in a play.

clue.text: The civic leader on trial put up a fight

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a test is a trial

explanation.surface: The mayor, standing trial, resisted.
explanation.definitionFit: To contest is to dispute or fight against something.

clue.text: Swindle quite happily, but make good

parts.note: to do someone is slang for cheating them
well means satisfactorily, in a good way

explanation.surface: A cheat lives contentedly but ends up successful.
explanation.definitionFit: To do well is to prosper, to succeed.

clue.text: Incarcerated these days for a period of five years

parts.note: pent means shut up or confined
AD, Anno Domini, marks the present era

explanation.surface: Locked up nowadays for a five-year stretch.
explanation.definitionFit: A pentad is a group of five, here five years.

clue.text: A little debonair energetic woman

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A small, suave and lively lady.
explanation.definitionFit: Irene is a female first name.

clue.text: Serviceable building material? One stands corrected!

indicators.note: the letters are put right, so the phrase before it is rearranged

explanation.surface: A useful material for building, with an admission of error.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandstone is a sedimentary rock widely used as a building stone.

clue.text: A quarter never mock

parts.note: south is one of the four quarters of the compass
ne'er is a poetic contraction of never

explanation.surface: One-fourth never makes fun.
explanation.definitionFit: To sneer is to scoff or deride.

clue.text: Such a belief is held by the married

indicators.note: the little word is held inside the two pieces that follow

explanation.surface: A conviction that married people share.
explanation.definitionFit: Theism is belief in the existence of a god.

clue.text: Flats for accommodating adults in principle

definitions.note: a plural word for a single block of flats

indicators.note: the principle takes the adults in, holding them inside

parts.note: a tenet is a principle or doctrine
men are adult males

explanation.surface: Apartments meant for housing grown-ups, in theory.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenement is a building divided into apartments, especially in a city.

clue.text: Repeatedly take in the right points by eye

parts.note: E and S are compass points, east and south
orb is a poetic word for eye

explanation.surface: Someone keeps absorbing the correct points by looking.
explanation.definitionFit: To resorb is to absorb again, re- signalling repetition.

clue.text: Set about doing without cash when scared

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the start word surrounds the cash

parts.note: to start is to set about doing
L stands for pound, the British currency sign

explanation.surface: Beginning to go without money brings fright.
explanation.definitionFit: Startled means alarmed or frightened suddenly.
